Over 600 E3 ubiquitin ligases are expressed in humans
desalting using C18 solid phase extraction plates (SOLA, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
Desalted peptides were dried in a vacuum-centrifuged and reconstituted in 1.0% formic acid for LC-MS analysis.
